name: Eventim.at
notes: www.eventim.at is now a pure B2B/corporate Webflow site (career, partnerships, contact) with zero event data — confirmed via sitemap.xml, which lists only /karriere, /partnerschaft, /kontakt etc. The actual AT consumer ticket shop, www.oeticket.com (also part of CTS Eventim), hard-blocks non-browser clients at the connection level (Akamai): curl gets no response at all on / or /robots.txt over both HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1 (timeout, HTTP 000), even with a browser UA. No accessible event data on either domain.
